name: Andrew McGreevy
memory: Every visit to the Prisuta house, Wesley amazed me with how strong and full of life he was. Through everything, he was enjoying every moment and soaking up every ounce of joy with his family.

name: Nat Giuffre
memory: I will always remember Wesley’s sweet smile and sparkling eyes every time I saw him. I cherish all the times I got to hold him and make him giggle. I loved watching him laugh at his siblings and love on Meg and Matt.

name: Gigi
memory: I remember walking into the playroom one day, and Wesley was bouncing in the jumper that hung from the doorway. He was as happy as could be and taking in all the activity around him with the cutest look on his face🥰His snuggles on my shoulder I still feel to this day❤️Every moment spent with our sweet Wes would bring sheer joy .. his adorable dimple smile .. his beautiful gaze into nature and the heavens .. his giggles and laughs with his family .. his precious praying hands 🙏 Thank you, God, for the gift of this angel who will live on in our hearts forever 💙🪽
